ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white/cream) to 35% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large bilateral high-intensity elliptical regions centered on each lobe, surrounded by continuous low-intensity margins. Localized yellow-brown chromatic shifts (diatom staining) are visible within the high-intensity patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 45-50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entirety of the trailing edge, with increased pixel-amplitude (jaggedness) near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curve along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white and dark circular pixel groups localized on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with calcified deposits.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel low-intensity linear marks; two primary diagonal marks on the left lobe and one significant curved line on the right lobe breaking the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized biological colonization (barnacles) on the outer margins of both fluke tips; multiple rake-like linear scars on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-tan staining concentrated in the central-interior regions of the white pigmented lobes.
